name: 폴리메레
fact: A 21-km P-type Trojan in Jupiter's leading swarm. After Lucy selected it as a target, Hubble follow-up observations revealed a previously-unknown satellite — a 5-km moonlet for which a name has yet to be approved.
bio: Discovered 1999, named for Polymele — mother of Patroclus in Homeric tradition. P-type asteroids feature reddish, featureless reflectance spectra interpreted as organic-rich and dehydrated; their dynamical history places them firmly among the primordial outer-disc planetesimals Lucy was designed to sample.
